text:
The customer has three requests: a corrected invoice for LM-46002 showing the right GST amount, cancellation of their Lumo Care subscription, and troubleshooting for a bedroom hub that disconnects every few hours. 

So far, the agent has cancelled the Lumo Care subscription effective November 30, collected the hub's firmware version (2.3.1), and escalated the disconnection issue to the technical team. 

Next, the finance team needs to reissue the corrected invoice within two days, and the technical team needs to review the firmware details and follow up on the hub disconnections.
